We value execution, velocity, and extreme ownership over everything else. Whether you have successfully exited a previous startup or have been the engineering/product powerhouse behind a high-velocity platform, we care about your ability to ship. If you have the product judgment to find market fit, the magnetic personality to attract elite talent, and the stamina to lead through the chaos of 0-to-1 growth, we will give you the infrastructure, capital, and leverage to build your legacy. We offer more than just a typical incubator slot; we offer the ultimate entrepreneurial unfair advantage. - De-Risked Innovation: Skip the agonizing months of chasing small checks to survive. We provide the baseline capital, operational plumbing, and institutional support so you can focus entirely on building. - A Culture of Momentum: Join an environment that despises red tape. Who You Are: - You’ve built something from scratch — as a founder or early engineer. You thrive when given a goal and minimal instructions. - You care about outcomes, not just implementation. You think in terms of user impact and business leverage. - You take initiative. You don’t wait for permission. You close loops. - You can explain trade-offs clearly — to engineers, operators, and leadership. - You can build modern web applications end-to-end (e.g., React, TypeScript, Python, Node). You’re comfortable integrating AI into real systems.
